next_issue.title: feat(compat): Pydantic v1 and v2 dual-compatibility shim for air-gapped sandboxes
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.8.0 Wave 1, enable debim to run seamlessly inside older Google Colab environments and Linux sandboxes with Pydantic 1.x without throwing `ImportError: cannot import name 'RootModel'`.

### Tasks
1. Create `src/debim/compat.py` providing unified exports for `RootModel`, `model_validator`, `field_validator`, and `ConfigDict` that fallback gracefully on Pydantic v1.
2. Update `src/debim/schema.py` and `src/debim/modular.py` to import from `debim.compat`.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_compat_pydantic.py` verifying model instantiation under both v1 and v2 semantics.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(resolver): local point offsets and arithmetic grid expressions on columns, footings, and walls
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.8.0 Wave 2, allow `offset_x` and `offset_y` directly on single-point and linear elements (`ColumnPlacement`, `FootingPlacement`, `WallPlacement`), and resolve arithmetic grid coordinates such as `grid: ['3 + 1.00', 'ข - 0.50']` and `from_grid: ['1 - 0.20', 'A']`.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/schema.py`: Add `offset_x: Optional[float] = 0.0` and `offset_y: Optional[float] = 0.0` to `ColumnPlacement`, `FootingPlacement`, and `WallPlacement`.
2. In `src/debim/resolver.py`: Support string arithmetic expressions in single-point `grid` and line `from_grid`/`to_grid` coordinates.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_point_offsets.py` verifying displaced columns (carport offsets) and cantilever wall alignments.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(macros): structural framing array macros (ColumnGrid and BeamBay generator)
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.8.0 Wave 3, eliminate manual repetitive coding of 50+ columns and 70+ beams by introducing `macro_elements:` with `ColumnGrid` and `BeamBay`.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/schema.py`: Define `ColumnGrid` and `BeamBay` macro specifications with `grids_x: List[str]`, `grids_y: List[str]`, profiles, storeys, and `except_points: Optional[List[Tuple[str, str]]]`.
2. In `src/debim/modular.py` and `loader.py`: Expand macro elements into discrete `IfcColumn` and `IfcBeam` elements during manifest parsing.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_framing_macros.py` verifying generation of 20+ columns and beams from a single macro definition.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(viewer): smart floor isolation toggle in 3D WebGL and net wall opening deduction in QTO
next_issue.body:
### Overview
As part of debim v0.8.0 Wave 4, add smart floor isolation controls in the 3D WebGL viewer and deduct door/window openings from wall surface areas in QTO.

### Tasks
1. In `src/debim/viewer.py`: Add interactive storey filter buttons (`[All Storeys]`, `[FL1]`, `[FL2]`, etc.) in the Three.js HTML viewer to isolate and inspect interior framing.
2. In `src/debim/qto.py`: Deduct `host_wall` door and window opening cutouts from gross wall surface areas for net plaster and masonry take-off.
3. Add unit tests in `tests/test_viewer_and_net_qto.py`.
next_issue.label: jules
